paragraphs: Mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 93:6 and Tanchuma, Vayigash 6.[^1]

notes.text: ב״ר פצ״ג־ו and תנחומא ויגש־ו are read as Bereshit Rabbah 93:6 and Tanchuma Vayigash 6. The exact editions, including standard versus Buber Tanchuma, are not specified or independently checked. The abbreviated title remains R'.
